api/shared/access_checks.py.name: Access check recorder
api/shared/access_checks.py.description: Records each permission decision as a request runs, so administrators can see exactly why someone was allowed or refused.

api/shared/access_trace_storage.py.name: Access trace storage
api/shared/access_trace_storage.py.description: Stores recorded permission checks in a compact form and reads them back for the access log view.

api/shared/account_guards.py.name: Account safety rules
api/shared/account_guards.py.description: Blocks changes that would leave the workspace without an administrator or give outside users privileged access.

api/shared/auth_cookies.py.name: Browser sign-in cookies
api/shared/auth_cookies.py.description: Keeps a signed-in person's browser pass intact even for large accounts, and clears it properly on sign-out.

api/shared/browser_impersonation.py.name: Support view as user
api/shared/browser_impersonation.py.description: Lets an administrator see the platform as a specific person for a short time, with the session recorded and revocable.

api/shared/claims/__init__.py.name: Rule facts package
api/shared/claims/__init__.py.description: Groups the pieces that work out the facts a permission rule may depend on.

api/shared/claims/preresolve.py.name: Gathering rule facts
api/shared/claims/preresolve.py.description: Looks up every fact a set of permission rules depends on before checking them, so a decision never stalls halfway.

api/shared/claims/registry.py.name: Shared fact list
api/shared/claims/registry.py.description: Keeps the workspace's named facts that permission rules may use, and spots definitions that depend on each other in a circle.

api/shared/external_access.py.name: Provider workspace marker
api/shared/external_access.py.description: Notes at sign-in whether a person belongs to the provider's own workspace, so provider-only rules can apply.

api/shared/file_access.py.name: File permission checks
api/shared/file_access.py.description: Decides whether someone may read, list or change a stored file, applying workspace, Solution and folder rules in order.

api/shared/file_paths.py.name: File location naming
api/shared/file_paths.py.description: Works out where a file actually lives from its named location, workspace and path.

api/shared/file_policies_seed.py.name: New folder defaults
api/shared/file_policies_seed.py.description: Gives each new shared folder a starting rule that lets administrators through while other rules are added.

api/shared/file_policies.py.name: Folder permission rules
api/shared/file_policies.py.description: Chooses the most specific rule for a folder and path, then checks one action against it.

api/shared/human_sessions.py.name: Staying signed in
api/shared/human_sessions.py.description: Issues and refreshes the passes that keep a person signed in, and can end every session for an account at once.

api/shared/policies/__init__.py.name: Permission rules package
api/shared/policies/__init__.py.description: Groups the pieces that store, check and apply the platform's permission rules.

api/shared/policies/compile.py.name: Rules as database filters
api/shared/policies/compile.py.description: Turns permission rules into a database filter, so lists only return the records a person may see.

api/shared/policies/evaluate.py.name: Rule checker
api/shared/policies/evaluate.py.description: Judges one record against one permission rule for one person, without touching stored data.

api/shared/policies/functions.py.name: Rule helper list
api/shared/policies/functions.py.description: Keeps the set of built-in helpers that permission rules are allowed to use.

api/shared/policies/probe.py.name: Permission probes
api/shared/policies/probe.py.description: Answers common permission questions, such as whether any record is readable or one action is allowed.

api/shared/policies/subscription.py.name: Live table visibility
api/shared/policies/subscription.py.description: Decides which table changes each viewer receives live, including when an edit makes a record appear or vanish for them.

api/shared/resource_access.py.name: App, form and agent access
api/shared/resource_access.py.description: Decides who may open, change or inspect an app, form or agent the workspace owns.

api/shared/role_cache.py.name: Role lookup cache
api/shared/role_cache.py.description: Remembers each person's roles so checks stay fast, and refreshes them the moment a role changes.

api/shared/scope_resolver.py.name: Workspace reach
api/shared/scope_resolver.py.description: Works out which workspaces a request may touch, refusing anything outside the signed-in person's reach.

api/shared/system_account_guard.py.name: System account guard
api/shared/system_account_guard.py.description: Stops the platform's own automation account from being given a human role.

api/shared/workflow_access.py.name: Workflow tool access
api/shared/workflow_access.py.description: Answers the single question of whether a person may use a workflow as a tool inside an agent.
